limitation.note: The public API does not let you control paging for this part of the response. The items expansion returns invoice items without per-invoice paging control via public OQ REST. The bill_to expansion (billtocontact) returns a single object and does not require paging. The sold_to expansion has no public REST expand; the invoice response carries only soldToContactId, and the sold-to contact must be fetched separately using GET /object-query/contacts/{key}. For per-invoice item paging, use the invoice items list operation with a filter on invoice_id to retrieve items for a specific invoice independently. Do not pass sold_to or soldTo in expand[]; it is silently ignored by the API and the contact must be fetched via a separate contact lookup. No vetted GraphQL example is available.
